title: Did the puzzle solver get faster in the second week?
description: A student who likes puzzles records the seconds taken for Sudoku puzzles in two weeks. A dot plot is built for both weeks, then the mean and median of each week are found and compared.
teaching_notes: One idea: two weeks of different lengths are compared by their mean and median, not by their totals. Watch for children who compare the totals of nine puzzles and eight puzzles.

video_script.why: The child can find a mean and a median and now compares two groups of different sizes.
video_script.substitution: Means and medians let nine puzzles and eight puzzles be compared fairly.
video_script.payoff_line: The puzzle solver became faster in the second week.

final_answer.value: Week 1: mean 360 s, median 360 s; Week 2: mean 278.75 s, median 275 s
final_answer.spoken: the puzzle solver became faster in the second week

maths_rules: dot plot: a line from 200 to 420 in steps of 20, one colour for each week
about 80 seconds less on average (360 - 278.75 = 81.25); 380 in week 2 is far from the rest
check: week 1 has 4 values below 360 and 4 above; week 2 has 4 below 275 and 4 above
video_script.design: One number line from 200 to 420. Week 1 dots in one colour above the line, week 2 dots in another colour below it.
open_questions: The book names the puzzle solver Aditi, who is in the overflow list of name slots, so the script says the puzzle solver.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>A dot plot puts one dot on a number line for each time.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>The total divided by the number of times is called the mean.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>The middle of the sorted times is called the median.
<bookmark mark='m4'/>We solve it the same way as the example in your book.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Given, the first week has nine times.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>They are four hundred and ten, four hundred, three hundred and seventy and three hundred and forty.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Then come three hundred and sixty and four hundred. Next are three hundred and twenty, three hundred and thirty and three hundred and ten.
<bookmark mark='m4'/>The second week has eight times.
<bookmark mark='m5'/>They are three hundred and twenty and two hundred and ninety. Then come three hundred and eighty and two hundred and eighty.
<bookmark mark='m6'/>Then come two hundred and seventy and two hundred and thirty. Last are two hundred and twenty and two hundred and forty.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>We have to draw a dot plot for both weeks, and describe the mean and the median.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Step one, draw the dot plot. Use a line from two hundred to four hundred and twenty, in steps of twenty.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Put one dot for each time of week one. Two dots stack at four hundred.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Use another colour for the dots of week two.

marks.m1: the nine times are added and 3240 is written
marks.m3: the times are sorted and the fifth glows

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Step two, find the mean and median of week one. The nine times add up to three thousand two hundred and forty.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Divide by nine. The mean is three hundred and sixty seconds.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Sort the times. With nine values, the median is the fifth value.
<bookmark mark='m4'/>It is three hundred and sixty seconds.

marks.m1: the eight times are added and 2230 is written
marks.m3: the times are sorted and the fourth and fifth glow

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Step three, find the mean and median of week two. The eight times add up to two thousand two hundred and thirty.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Divide by eight. The mean is two hundred and seventy eight point seven five seconds.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Sort the times. With eight values, the median is halfway between the fourth and fifth values. Those are two hundred and seventy and two hundred and eighty.
<bookmark mark='m4'/>Half of five hundred and fifty is two hundred and seventy five seconds.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Step four, compare the two weeks. The mean of week two is about eighty seconds less.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>The median of week two is also less, by eighty five seconds.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>One time in week two, three hundred and eighty, is far from the rest.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>The puzzle solver became faster in the second week.
